content: Ideally the DM's policy would be trained by interacting with real users. Although there are models that support on-line learning BIBREF15 , for the majority of RL algorithms, which require a lot of interactions, this is impractical. Furthermore, a set of users needs to be recruited every time a policy is trained. This makes common practices such as hyper-parameter optimization prohibitively expensive. Thus, it is natural to try to learn from a dataset which needs to be recorded only once, but can be used over and over again.
